evidence: Mechanically updates assertion includes across more than 150 unit test, fuzz, and benchmark files.
rationale: This PR is a mechanical cleanup to ensure test files include `<util/check.h>` directly when invoking assertions. The author notes it prevents compile errors when compiled without assertions in `util/check.h` and aids IWYU tooling, but as a test codebase include refactor it offers marginal value and has no special claim on scarce review attention.
